projects.title: Compact - All-In-One Organizer
projects.description: A simplicity-driven app that provides users an encompassing experience of productivity, featuring customizable widgets like To-Do, Budgeting, Addictions, Diary, and more.

projects.title: LinearPlot3D
projects.description: LinearPlot3D is a web application that displays animation to help students understand the concept of linear algebra in 3D space and professors to teach the concept of linear algebra in 3D space.

projects.title: ClipboardHistory
projects.description: The app keeps track of textual clipboard history data and allows the user to copy previous clipboard data using ctrl + <number>

projects.title: Available Date Formatter
projects.description: Drag across a week grid to mark when you're free or busy, then copy it as text, an image, a share link, or an .ics file. Everything runs in the browser — availability lives in the URL hash, so nothing is uploaded.

projects.title: GitHub Pie Chart
projects.description: A pie chart of anyone's GitHub contributions grouped by repo, served as an SVG you can embed in a README. No build step and no dependencies — one serverless function, plus a live configurator that builds the snippet for you.

projects.title: RSVP Reader
projects.description: A minimalist speed reader that flashes words one at a time using Rapid Serial Visual Presentation, aligning each word on its Optimal Recognition Point so your eyes stay still. Adjustable from 100 to 800 WPM, with a fullscreen focus mode and keyboard shortcuts.

projects.title: Kaomoji Keyboard
projects.description: An iOS custom keyboard for browsing, searching, and inserting 800+ Japanese-style text emoticons anywhere you type, with mood categories, keyword search, and usage-based sorting. It never requests Full Access and makes no network calls.
